objective: Test heartbeat/status traffic and whether a second START can append while a sequence is active.

tests.title: Long sequence with heartbeat
tests.purpose: Keep a sequence active across the normal heartbeat interval.
tests.summary: 20 balls at 0.8 Hz with heartbeat enabled
tests.question: Did heartbeat traffic coincide with a physical pause or interruption?

tests.title: Attempt active buffer append
tests.purpose: Send a second bounded START while the first sequence should still be running, without STOP.
tests.summary: 12-ball START, then an 8-ball START about 4 s later
tests.heartbeat: normal; one status/heartbeat probe before append
tests.question: Did the second group continue smoothly without a stop or reset?
